items.title: Adrian Cunningham interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, March 31, 2021
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Did you know other Australian musicians who had done the same think, like Lisa and Nicki Parrott? ... [INTERVIEWEE] I knew of them.

ctx.x: So I could see doing this as a living, the light bulb moment that was the end of high school, and so then I went to audition for the conservatory of the music, which was the jazz, THE jazz course in Sydney. And the first year out of school I didn’t get in because I didn’t really know what I was doing, you know I think I kind of played a blues or something and I didn’t pass the audition because it was a very small intake and it was very competitive, and you know there’s a lot of great musicians. So I didn’t get in…
Did you know other Australian musicians who had done the same think, like Lisa and Nicki Parrott? And did that have advice for you?

I knew of them. I think I met Nicki maybe a year or so after moving here, and we’ve played together a lot since then at a lot of festivals, and Nicki is one of the coolest. She’s great. But there’s some musicians in New York, because Nicki doesn’t live in New York, she lives in Connecticut so she wasn’t really kind of hanging out. But there are a couple of musicians here when I moved here, Jason Campbell, a guitar player. He has subsequently moved back to Australia. Since Covid he kind of moved his family over,…
